parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数，缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The platform type. Valid values: saml, oauth2, or custom
parameters.help_zh: 平台类型: saml / oauth2 / custom
parameters.name: platform_type

parameters.help_en: The enterprise identifier. This value must match the corpId returned by listAvailableConfigs
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识（必须与 listAvailableConfigs 返回的 corpId 一致）
parameters.name: corp_id

parameters.help_en: The SSO configuration ID. For SAML/OAuth2, this parameter is optional. If not specified, the value is automatically derived based on corpId. If multiple IdPs use the same corpId, you must explicitly specify this parameter. Otherwise, an AMBIGUOUS error is returned. This parameter is not required for custom
parameters.help_zh: SSO 配置 ID（SAML/OAuth2 可选：不传时按 corpId 自动推导；若存在多个 IdP 使用相同 corpId 则必须显式传入，否则报 AMBIGUOUS 错误；custom 不需要）
parameters.name: sso_settings_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronize member relationships. In custom mode, this parameter is forced to false
parameters.help_zh: 是否同步成员关系（custom 模式强制为 false）
parameters.name: sync_members

fields.help_en: The department ID. This is an external identifier. The client is responsible for ensuring uniqueness
fields.help_zh: 部门 ID（外部标识，客户端自行保证唯一性）
fields.name: dept_id

fields.help_en: The sort order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
fields.help_zh: 排序号（数值越小越靠前）
fields.name: order

fields.help_en: The parent department ID. A value of null indicates a top-level department or root department
fields.help_zh: 父部门 ID（null 表示一级部门/根部门）
fields.name: parent_dept_id

parameters.help_en: The department list. At least one root department must be included
parameters.help_zh: 部门列表（至少包含一个根部门）
parameters.name: departments

fields.help_en: The user identifier. In the SAML scenario, this is an email address or UPN, which must match rbj_user_account.account_id
fields.help_zh: 用户标识（SAML 场景为邮箱/UPN，需与 rbj_user_account.account_id 匹配）
fields.name: account_id

fields.help_en: The department ID to which the member belongs. This value must correspond to a deptId in the departments list
fields.help_zh: 所属部门 ID（必须与 departments 中的 deptId 对应）
fields.name: dept_id

fields.help_en: The username for display purposes. This parameter is optional
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en: The member list. This parameter is required when syncMembers is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 成员列表（syncMembers=true 时必须提供）
parameters.name: members

schema.description_en: The response for pushing organizational structure synchronization
schema.description_zh: 推送组织架构同步响应

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success. A failure returns a backend error code (ERR.* / InvalidParameter.*)
code.description_zh: 业务状态码：成功为 200，失败为后端错误码（ERR.* / InvalidParameter.*）

message.description_en: The error description. This value is empty when the request is successful

status.description_en: The initial status of the task

taskId.description_en: The asynchronous synchronization task ID, used for polling the status through querySyncResult
taskId.description_zh: 异步同步任务 ID，用于 querySyncResult 轮询状态
